_comment: Based on Facebook/Meta BGP withdrawal incident 2021-10-04. https://engineering.fb.com/2021/10/05/networking-traffic/outage-details/
incident: Backbone router maintenance config command accidentally withdrew all BGP prefix announcements, making DNS and all services globally unreachable for 6h32m

primary_fix_commit.message: fix: restore BGP route announcements after backbone config withdrawal
